# SMIT Digital Marketing Pvt. Ltd. (SMIT Digital Marketing)

SMIT Digital Marketing Pvt. Ltd. is a Marketing Services company. SMIT Digital Marketing Pvt. Ltd. employs 2 people and has an annual revenue of $4.6M, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with presence in United States.

## About

SMIT Digital Marketing - Empowering Digital Agencies Worldwide with Private Label Services

Meet the Digital Marketing Mavericks that help you get ahead in business race! With more than 12+ years of business existence, the team at SMIT has mastered the art to capitalize its experiential learning with the right Tips & Tricks to impactful marketing for impeccable performance. 

SMIT is a full-service Digital Marketing back office for small to mid-sized businesses besides offering white-labelled solutions to existing Digital Agencies worldwide. 

Our service portfolio includes Search Optimization & Marketing including Local SEO, E-commerce Search Marketing, Paid Ads, Social Media Account Management, Social Media Paid Campaigns, Creatives Designing, Video Creation, Content Writing, Influencer Endorsements & Performance Marketing. 

The current set of our clients also include Website Design & Development agencies, Branding & Marketing Agencies, Online Shopping Portals besides Event Management Companies. Our proficiency includes working across global platforms like Meta, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, etc. with a deep understanding of their respective Web Analytics. 

Here’s some of our noteworthy pointers: 12+ Years in Business | 150+ Retainer Clients | 87% Client Retention Ratio | 32% Referral Client Rate | 23+ Industries Worked For | 7+ Recognition Received

We are highly confident about our services because no matter the number of AI tools in the market, what you need is Humans to deliver!

So, want us to be your 'business buddies' to spearhead your business and make it more productive. Call/Email us NOW to schedule an Online Meet sooner!
